name: escalate
_comment: Exercises both escalation tiers of the developer-centric chain. The Claude Developer review (arch.dev_review) returns the SAME NEEDS_REVISION each cycle -> Architect<->Developer deadlock -> Tech Lead arbitrates with a binding ruling (ARCHITECT_REVIEW_NEEDS_REVISION); the developer still blocks and the ruling repeats -> Architect<->Tech-Lead deadlock -> Arbiter (DeepSeek) returns NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION -> HUMAN_REQUIRED.

arch.arbiter:
### Arbitration Verdict

NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION

### Dispute Summary
- The Developer says the design overflows a fixed-size buffer budget and must be bounded; the Architect and Tech Lead cannot converge on the footprint tradeoff.

### Final Note for Human
- This is a scope/footprint tradeoff; Irina should decide.
